notes.title: Feed The Gods out now!
notes.notes:
Dead Cultists!

This day has finally come. [b]Rise to greatness in Feed The Gods![/b] Become a chosen mortal, a daring card-battler who braves the dark halls of forgotten dungeons, faces impossible odds, and earns divine favor by offering their spoils to the ever-hungry gods.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2918960/Feed_The_Gods/

This time, you'll be joining this epic clans to get your victory:
[list]
[*] [b]Children of Growth[/b] - forest dwellers, whose masks and rituals reflect a connection to ancient spirits.
[*] [b]Chained Brotherhood[/b] - treacherous monks cursed by their deity for their unquenchable bloodlust.
[*] [b]Seaweed Bloaters[/b] - benevolent fishmen, who want to return to the shore and become human again.
[*] [b]Knights of Hedone[/b] - fearless knights, nobly defending people from the evil gods.
[*] [b]Mistresses of Inner Sight[/b] -  a coven of witches bravely rising up against oppression and injustice.
[*] [b]Witnesses of Rock[/b] - stone spirits imbued with the mysterious magic of unknown worlds.
[*] [b]The Ancient[/b] -  the ravenous hungry Ancient Deity. Dangerous and deadly.
[/list][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044568/1728deeaabc4e6d2175e0318ca6d1e6d7cc23328.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044568/1728deeaabc4e6d2175e0318ca6d1e6d7cc23328.gif[/img][/url]

With a team of heroes ready to rise to the challenge, Feed The Gods combines:
[list]
[*] [b]A fast and accessible card-battling system[/b] that rewards bold strategies
[*] [b]A rich, hand-painted art style[/b] inspired by shadowy dungeons and forgotten relics
[*] [b]Atmospheric soundscapes and immersive audio[/b], crafted to draw you deeper into the gods' world.
[/list]What are you waiting for? Answer the call of the divine! Master your deck, defeat other challengers, and deliver the ultimate tribute to appease the gods themselves.

[i]PS: Offerings are non-refundable. May the gods favor you… or consume you.
[/i]PPS: if you encounter any bugs/typos or want to share you feedback - don't hesitate to [url=https://discord.gg/aUsdawUnRh]join our Discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2918960/discussions/]ping us in Discussions[/url]!

notes.title: Feed The Gods Release Date
notes.notes:
Dear Cultists,

The Ancient One stir, hungry for devotion and sacrifice. 
Feed The Gods emerges from the shadows, summoning you to prove your worth.[b] On Friday The 13[/b], the ritual begins—an easy-to-learn, yet unforgiving card battle experience steeped in the dread of dark dungeons and the echo of haunting chants. 

Or simply to say - mark your calendars, [b]Feed The Gods will be released on December 13th[/b]! 

Prepare your offerings, sharpen your wits, and ready yourselves to face the unfathomable. They are waiting —will you answer their call?..

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2918960/Feed_The_Gods

notes.title: Dev Diary #4 - Release Date and future plans!
notes.notes:
Dear Cult Leaders,

TedRed team here. 

Wow, It's been a long time since we've been in touch. And 2024 is almost at an end. But it doesn't mean that we forgot about Feed The Gods. We have a lot of good news!

[h3][b]RELEASE SOON[/b][/h3]

We'll post an announcement in near future, so stay tuned!

And here are some features to look forward to in the game at release:
[list]
[*] Multiplayer support for up to 6 people
[*] Deck building Mode
[*] 20+ hand drawn animated avatars
[*] French, Chinese and Russian localization
[*] Achievements
[*] Very hungry Ancient One who is ready to accept your sacrifices…
[/list]
Of course, you'll have to play a bit at the beginning to get all the bonuses. But we believe in you!
If you're still in doubt - a demo of our game is always available, give it a try :)

[h3][b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044568/2c9084800f285ed413d00a2a2d15269b56778905.jpg[/img]

If you've read our previous dev blogs, you know how hard it is sometimes to stop our artist.
He decided it was time for drawing some achievements. Without further ado - we'll just show them to you right now.

[h3][b]BUGS
[/b][/h3]

If during the game you have any problems / bugs / you found a typo - do not hesitate to write to us in Steam Discussions or our Discord channel!
Any comment will help us make the game better.


That’s the end of our fourth Dev Diary! Here's the link to push a 'Wishlist' button :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2918960/Feed_The_Gods/

Be the first to know about it and join [url=https://discord.gg/UKfZNgVKud]our Discord[/url]!
And please ask any questions in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2918960/discussions/]Discussions[/url]!

notes.title: Dev Diary #3 - Join The Playtest next week!
notes.notes:
Dear Cult Leaders,

TedRed team here. 

September is already coming to an end, and we’re not only fixing all the bugs in the world like crazy, but also adding new features to the game we would like to test with you. No time to relax, as we have another playtest to run next week!

[h3]A PLAYTEST NEXT WEEK - SEPTEMBER 27-30[/h3]
The next playtest kicks off Friday, 27 September 2024 18:00 16:00 UTC (9:00 AM PDT, 12:00 PM EDT) and continues until Monday, 30 September 2024 16:00 UTC (9:00 AM PDT, 12:00 PM EDT). 

[b]How to Join on Steam[/b]
Visit the Feed The Gods Steam store page starting today, and click "Request Access" under "Join Feed The Gods Playtest" to sign up. We will start confirming access daily after the playtest goes live. Those selected will be promptly notified. 
Feed The Gods is a party game. We highly recommend bringing your friends with you! If you want to finds someone to play with - join our Discord and leave your message in #⁠lfg channel! 

This is our last open playtest, but not the last opportunity for you to try out the game! 

[h3]JOINING TO ONGOING GAME AS A SPECTATOR[/h3]
Now you can connect to the game and watch cultists fight for their lives! 
You'll have to wait until players finish the match. Afterward you’ll join the lobby as one of the active players automatically. We’re adding this to help discover games for sole players, who wish to join the random party but don’t want to catch them in the lobby.

[h3]TRY OUT TUTORIAL[/h3]
As we mentioned before we added a tutorial match to the game. We would like you to try it out and say what you think. Hopefully for newer players the tutorial would be comprehensive enough to play against other players knowingly.

[h3]DECK BUILDING FEATURE[/h3]
This is an experimental feature we would like you to try out. We’re not yet sure it would go into the game on release, but essentially each player has their own deck with special cards that they are allowed to draw from. The common deck has only cards to move your cultists, so you need to choose which cards you prefer to use on your turn. This also important because after the common deck is depleted, the discard is shuffled and all cards you have used will be available to draw for your opponents.

[h3]MORE AVATARS[/h3]
We just can't stop our artist. He paints and paints and paints.....
But it's beautiful! Now you have a choice of almost 29 avatars for any taste. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044568/85584ef34678212aebf270be1a26cee5dd5b4bf3.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044568/85584ef34678212aebf270be1a26cee5dd5b4bf3.gif[/img][/url]

[b]That’s the end of our third Dev Diary![/b]

If you're not already wishlisting Feed The Gods - you know what to do:

notes.title: Dev Diary #2 - Tutorial Update
notes.notes:
Dear Cult Leaders,

TedRed team’s here! 

We’re making some progress at full speed. There are still so many things we want to do! 
But more on that later. Today we’ll share some details about the tutorial. And a few other details as a bonus 🙂


[h3]TUTORIAL[/h3]
There’s no game without a tutorial. Our game had one too. However, only in picture form...
Last playtest showed us that things are not as easy as they seem. We spent a lot of time explaining how the basic game loop works in Discord, while playing with our testers.
After many hours of internal discussions and several versions, we finally have a full-fledged tutorial!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044568/8acb196843d7a818ce8273313f9a007b54163b0b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044568/34cab34960646e898d124647f3620d956d791026.png[/img]

The tutorial will show you:
[list]
[*]what is your main purpose in the game
[*]how to use cards and what they mean
[*]about the player's turn itself
[*]and the opponent's turn of course
[*]all UI tips you need to understand
[/list]
The tutorial button will always be in the game. If you forget something, you can always replay it.

[h3]NEW AVATARS[/h3]
Even though the main visuals of the game are ready, we’re always thinking about what else we can add to the game.
Besides new features, we want to add some fancy things. That's why we’ve expanded the number of avatars. For all players of all tastes. Cool, right? 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044568/3d844216f9e3cb7a163a119949ddb6ee325dd1f7.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044568/3d844216f9e3cb7a163a119949ddb6ee325dd1f7.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Dev Diary #1 - Playtest Results
notes.notes:
Dear Cult Leaders!

TedRed team’s here. 
If you see this for the first time - we develop Feed The Gods.

[b]Feed The Gods is a multiplayer card battler game.[/b] With powerful cards, you have to escape the pit of doom and leave your opponents at the bottom as a sacrifice to the gods.
Take the lead of one of the cultist’s member, use your cards wisely, cheat, lie and stay on top!

[b]Last week we ran our first playtest![/b] And we want to thank everyone who participated in it. We got a lot of useful feedback over the 3 days! That means a lot to us. And we still have much to do until the release.

Now let’s shed some light on what features and fixes [b]we’ll focus on next month[/b].
[h3]TUTORIAL[/h3]
As a team, we always test new features on ourselves. And it seemed like the game was easy to understand. Yeah, that was a big mistake that we plan to fix most of all!
In previous versions, we had a “HOW TO PLAY” button. 
For the next playtest we want to make a real, easy-to-understand tutorial. First test session will include detailed explanations of the interface and in-game mechanics.
And you can’t skip it, sorry, The Ancient totally won’t approve of it.
[h3]JOINING THE GAME[/h3]
Ah, that’s the easy one. Players will connect to understaffed lobbies when the party is in the current game. You'll have to wait until they're done, but you can start the next session with that group automatically.
[h3]MORE SOUNDTRACK[/h3]
The playtest build had a lot of cool sounds, but very little soundtrack. Fear not, we’re still have much to add:
[list][*] More tunes are coming
[*] Three levels of music intensity
[*] Each intensity will consist of 3-4 randomly switched loops
[*] Switching of intensity happens depending of cultists quantity on certain level of tower
[*] You won’t be bored with it, we promise!![/list][h3]MINOR BUGS AND SO ON[/h3]
You know how it goes. Someone always must clean up the tower.
Leave it to us! We plan to fix things here and there. And there’s always more. 
If you notice a critical bug and something went wrong in the game - please, don’t hesitate to leave a feedback! It will help us get things back in order and make the game better.


[b]That’s the end of our first Dev Diary![/b]

If you're not already wishlisting Feed The Gods, consider doing it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2918960/Feed_The_Gods/

Again - thanks to all our playtesters! We’ve prepared a special Discord role for you all. If you still don’t have it - give us a sign and ping us in feedback channels.

[b]The next playtest will be held in September. 
Be the first to know about it and join our Discord[/b] - https://discord.gg/UKfZNgVKud


PS: please ask any questions in Discussions! We’re always happy to chat :)
